query: UPDATE scan_runs SET state = 'failed', finished_at = now() WHERE id IN ( SELECT r.id FROM scan_runs r WHERE r.state IN ('queued','running') AND r.total_tasks = 0 AND r.created_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $1) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_tasks t WHERE t.run_id = r.id) ORDER BY r.created_at ASC LIMIT $2 ) RETURNING id
